avoid: Check film titles and whether clips contain dialogue after it submits film clip logs.
Avoid subtitle tasks that require hearing the original speech clearly or identifying the language.
Avoid editing choices that rely entirely on taste, with no rules to consult.
When revision feedback is ambiguous, have someone check the full list of options it proposes.
Avoid small tasks that need an immediate reply. Starting a task and sending images both add overhead.
give: Assign Review tasks that involve finding picture and audio issues when the schedule allows. It got the content right on all three.
Assign revisions when the feedback is clear. It worked quickly and made no unrelated changes.
Assign routine Voiceover Editing and spot-check the harder parts after delivery.
Have it check proper names in subtitles against the script.
Have it find shots and check whether the target shots exist in the source footage.

Most mistakes involved film titles or whether a clip contained dialogue.
